title: Prove an all-depth QQ16 producer component grid
body:
## Summary

```diff
- QQ16 F0 -> B_1_2 component format: exactly one tensor layer
+ Every integer tensor depth lambda >= 1
+ quantum h*2^(-71-19(lambda-1))
+ signed width P+215+38(lambda-1)
```

Prove a source-bound numerical implementation contract for the literal full-cover producer, with all 704 bounded dirty persistent fields, eight zero private fields, native interiors and carried F0 state. PR3270's one-layer result retains its credit.

Symbolic numeric work is at most `(372322+110760 lambda)N+12` W-bit operations per owner, plus `2112N` conceptual cover transfers and `1426N+12` numeric storage words, where `N=2^(73 lambda)`. Tensor-native/bridge/cover/endpoint semantics are inherited. Address/sign/control/routing, an admitted entry grid, F17 consumption and recursive tariffs remain unpriced. No literal common-coordinate helper-restoration, supplier or kappa claim. PR3293 and PR3294 address different unused contracts.

Package: `research/qq16-all-depth-producer-grid/`, with proof, exact source pins, retained predecessor bytes, replay, limits and Open next questions. Canonical investigation: [#2727](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2727#discussioncomment-19004308).

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3270 explicitly leaves multi-layer native powering outside its one-layer guard.
  **After:** a symbolic induction in lambda bounds every native interior, with slopes 19 for grid and range. Its one-layer projection reproduces every primitive trace, stage-cut/state hash and operation count on 53,118 events and 270,288 observations.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay, separate explicit depth-1/2/3/8 arithmetic, five optimized behavioral groups, Ruff and warning-strict compilation pass. The numeric interpreter shares authenticated loading/expansion but no symbolic bound or dispatcher.
- All three registered/direct scripts actually pass from the committed regular-only, inode-disjoint, read-only Git-free export under normal CPython 3.12 and optimized 3.13. All 20 export hashes remain unchanged; 19 committed package/input byte checks pass. Pending predecessor Git objects are not required by fresh CI.
- Designated internal read-only review and its exact limits are recorded in REVIEW.json. This is computational review, separate from human/proof-kernel approval or selected-frontier admission. Full payload execution, inherited native proofs, Lean, Docker and selected cold replay are unrun.

```sh
python3 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/qq16-all-depth-producer-grid
```

Credit commdata2338/PR3226/3235, Nick Petalas/PR3270/2965, Sricharan Vagvala's pair-first reference and the retained Ali Romman/QQ16/native/geometry lineage. Source attribution is preserved in the package.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds one opt-in research package. No shared verifier, frozen source or selected-frontier change.
